settings.hero_subtitle: All products supplied by 3 Delta Dental are TGA (Therapeutic Goods Administration) registered and comply with Australian regulatory requirements. Your professional peace of mind is our priority.
settings.what_paragraph_1: The Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) is Australia's regulatory body for therapeutic goods, including medicines, medical devices, and dental materials. The TGA operates within the Australian Government's Department of Health, and its role is to protect public health by ensuring therapeutic goods are safe, effective, and of high quality.
settings.what_paragraph_2: Before any dental material can be legally supplied in Australia, it must be entered into the Australian Register of Therapeutic Goods (ARTG). The ARTG is a database of all therapeutic goods approved for supply in Australia, and each registered product receives a unique ARTG number that confirms its compliance status.
settings.what_link_label: Visit the TGA website for more information

settings.matters_item_3: Ensures materials meet Australian safety standards
settings.matters_item_4: Required for legal supply and use in Australia

settings.statement_paragraph_1: 3 Delta Dental is committed to supplying only TGA-registered dental materials. We will not supply non-registered products, regardless of price or availability pressure. This is not simply a legal obligation — it is a core part of how we operate.
settings.statement_paragraph_2: We maintain current ARTG registration documentation for all product lines we distribute. We actively monitor TGA updates and regulatory changes, and we work with our European manufacturer partners to ensure ongoing compliance. If a product's registration status changes, we notify affected customers immediately.
settings.statement_highlight: Every product in the 3 Delta Dental catalogue carries a current TGA registration number. Documentation is available on request — simply contact our compliance team.
settings.cert_subtitle: The following product categories in our catalogue are entered on the Australian Register of Therapeutic Goods (ARTG). Full documentation available on request.
settings.cert_note: ARTG registration certificates and TGA documentation for specific products are available on request. Contact our compliance team by phone or email with the product name or SKU and we will provide the relevant documentation within one business day.
settings.contact_text: Our compliance team can provide ARTG registration certificates, TGA documentation, and product safety data sheets for any product in our range. We aim to respond to all documentation requests within one business day.
settings.docs_text: Email our compliance team with the product name or SKU to request ARTG certificates, safety data sheets, or other compliance documentation.
